releases.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(commands): self-register slash commands via config hook (1.0.10) by @charfeng1 in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/17


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/compare/v1.0.9...v1.0.10

## What's Changed
* chore(ci): drop debug steps now that auto-publish works by @charfeng1 in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/12
* fix(plugin-loader): move COMPLETION_TAG out of entrypoint exports (1.0.9) by @charfeng1 in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/16


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/compare/v1.0.8...v1.0.9

## What's Changed
* fix: use os.homedir() fallback instead of literal tilde on Windows by @doomsday616 in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/1
* fix: use @opencode-ai/plugin tool() SDK to fix crash in opencode run by @Tolsi in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/5
* feat: CI gate + automated npm publishing with provenance by @charfeng1 in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/6
* fix(ci): use Node 24 for publish (skip broken npm self-upgrade) by @charfeng1 in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/7
* fix(ci): drop registry-url so OIDC trusted publishing engages by @charfeng1 in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/8
* fix(ci): explicit --provenance + ensure npm >= 11.5.1 by @charfeng1 in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/9
* fix(ci): JS-DevTools/npm-publish + OIDC claims debug by @charfeng1 in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/10
* debug(ci): show .npmrc + verbose npm publish by @charfeng1 in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/11

## New Contributors
* @doomsday616 made their first contribution in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/1
* @Tolsi made their first contribution in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/5
* @charfeng1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/pull/6

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop/commits/v1.0.8
